limitations: These are isolated Rust debug component benchmarks, not native Windows UI, installer, portable-bundle, or clean-desktop acceptance.
Threshold review requires both a greater-than-10-percent and greater-than-100-microsecond latency increase, or both a greater-than-10-percent and greater-than-2-MiB memory increase.
enqueueBatch has one sample per queue size in each run, so its p50, p95, and p99 are the same observation.
Disk and scheduler variation remains visible between pairs; an exact metric must repeat across all three matched repeats to establish a reproducible threshold regression.
Any source change after d1f6571 invalidates this receipt as final candidate evidence and requires a fresh matched comparison.
